name: aiml-access-doctor
description: A read-only shared identity and access diagnostic for all AI/ML services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lex, Textract, Comprehend, Rekognition, and others). For an AI/ML access-denied, it traces the full authorization chain - caller identity, IAM identity policy, service or execution role, role trust, PassRole, resource policy, and SCP or permission boundary - pinpoints the exact permission gap, and generates the minimal least-privilege IAM fix with no wildcards. Read-only. Recommends the Agent Toolkit for AWS or a custom IAM-analysis MCP and the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 08:00 UTC
